summary: feat(settings): record a Glean view event on the OAuth Permissions page
description:
Because:

- The OAuth Permissions page sends no Glean event.

This commit:

- Adds the Glean event oauth_permissions.view to the registry.
- Adds the generated web/oauthPermissions.ts and wires it into eventsMap and recordEventMetric.
- Records the event in the Permissions page with useGleanView.
- Adds unit, event-name and functional checks for the event.

Closes FXA-15122
